sources.quote: Aug 13, 2026 | x.com Facebook LinkedIn Mail Copy link Our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
sources.supports: Dates Google's announcement that introduced introductory Flash pricing.

sources.quote: 3.7 Flash delivers substantial improvements across software engineering, knowledge work, and web development workflows — with an introductory price of half the original 3.6 Flash cost per million tokens.
sources.supports: Google confirms the earlier 3.6 Flash cost was twice the newly introduced introductory price.

sources.quote: Take advantage of introductory pricing across Google AI Studio and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform through December 31, 2026 for Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.7 Flash, and Gemini 3.6 Flash. Standard pricing takes effect January 1, 2027.
sources.supports: Google explicitly includes Gemini 3.6 Flash in the introductory price period.

sources.quote: Input price Free of charge $0.75 through December 31, 2026. $1.50 starting January 1, 2027. Output price (including thinking tokens) Free of charge $3.75 through December 31, 2026. $7.50 starting January 1, 2027. Context caching price Free of charge $0.075 through December 31, 2026. $0.15 starting January 1, 2027.
sources.supports: Google's current pricing table lists the introductory and subsequent standard prices for Gemini 3.6 Flash.

notes: The earlier $1.50/$7.50/$0.15 rates were the genuine standard rates: Google described the new Flash introductory price as half the original 3.6 Flash cost. I date the drop to Google's Aug 13, 2026 announcement introducing the introductory-price period, though Google does not state a separate effective timestamp for the 3.6 price itself. The Internet Archive CDX endpoint returned HTTP 503, so no archived before/after snapshot bracket is available.
